title: Why Don’t Some People Use Chatbots?
summary_en: About half of U.S. adults never use chatbots, and most non-users cite disinterest, privacy or accuracy concerns.
title_cn: Why Don’t Some People Use Chatbots?

title: French Adults Stand Out for Their Economic Pessimism
summary_en: Amid protests, 85% of French adults say their economy is bad, a higher share than in any of 17 other high-income countries surveyed.
title_cn: French Adults Stand Out for Their Economic Pessimism

title: Iran Conflict Remains Deeply Unpopular as Many Americans Expect It To Go On for Months
summary_en: Around two-thirds (65%) now disapprove of the way President Donald Trump is handling the U.S. military action in Iran, while a third (33%) approve.
title_cn: Iran Conflict Remains Deeply Unpopular as Many Americans Expect It To Go On for Months

title: Cost Concerns Dominate as Public’s Economic Ratings Turn More Negative
summary_en: The costs of many household essentials are a top economic concern for most Americans – much as they were four years ago on the eve of the last midterm election.
title_cn: Cost Concerns Dominate as Public’s Economic Ratings Turn More Negative

title: With Americans in a Sour Mood, Democratic Voters Are More Engaged in Midterms
summary_en: The 2026 midterm election comes amid deep public dissatisfaction with the state of the nation and near-record low approval ratings for Trump.
title_cn: With Americans in a Sour Mood, Democratic Voters Are More Engaged in Midterms
